question_en: How do I finish this lesson?
answer_en: Scroll to the end of the lesson and press Mark as complete. Your progress is saved.

question_en: Where is the course outline or menu?
answer_en: Press the Menu button at the top left. It opens the course outline with every section of this lesson.

question_en: How do I switch to another course?
answer_en: Press My courses at the top of the page. A list of your courses opens. Choose one.

question_en: Where can I see my programme details?
answer_en: On the dashboard, press Programme details. A window opens with your programme name, dates and support contact.

question_en: Where do I see my score?
answer_en: On the dashboard, press Score details. A window shows your score for each week.

question_en: How do I go to another week?
answer_en: On the dashboard, use the week strip near the top. Press a week number to see that week's work.

question_en: How do I go to the next lesson?
answer_en: Use the curriculum bar at the bottom of the lesson page. Press Next concept.

question_en: Can I talk to a person?
answer_en: Yes. Press Talk to a person at the top of this panel. You see what will be sent before anything is sent.

question_en: What does a virtual assistant do?
answer_en: A virtual assistant supports a business from a distance. Common tasks are managing email, scheduling meetings, entering data, answering customer messages, booking travel and preparing simple reports.

question_en: Why is demand for virtual assistants growing?
answer_en: More companies hire remote workers. Small businesses can hire a VA for a few hours a week, and remote hiring lets work continue across time zones.

question_en: Which tools does a virtual assistant use?
answer_en: Email, a shared calendar, a spreadsheet program, a document editor, a video call app and a task board. Many clients also use a password manager.

question_en: Which skills do employers ask for?
answer_en: Clear written communication, good time management, attention to detail and reliability. Working without close supervision is important too.
The lesson says AI changes VA work but does not remove it. Clients still need a person who checks the work and makes judgement calls.

question_en: What should be in my portfolio?
answer_en: Three strong examples, such as a sample schedule, a cleaned spreadsheet, a well written email or a short report. Remove private client details first.
